provenance.method: No page of this 760-page PDF has a text layer (pdftotext returns only the literal string 'CamScanner'), so the page was rendered locally with pdftoppm at 600 dpi and read directly from the raster. No OCR was used for any value here.
provenance.extracted_by: coordinator session, after the three delegated extraction agents were terminated by an account session limit
provenance.notes: Arabic and Bengali are complete for all seven printed ayat and the separate basmala. All five instruction bands are now transcribed: 36 signs in total. Every meaning comes from this edition's OWN footer legend, which the coordinator rendered and read directly from PDF page 4 (ক ক্বলক্বলাহ, শ শিষ, গ গুন্নাহ, ম মোটা, ৭ ইখফা, oval-wedge আরবী সাকিন) and PDF page 5 (১ এক আলিফ, ২ দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ, ৩ তিন আলিফ, ৪ চার আলিফ, ৬ দম ফেলিলে তিন / না ফেলিলে এক). No meaning was written from general tajweed knowledge. All 36 sign boxes and all25 word boxes were remeasured in the Codex independent audit. Every sign now has a source box and an explicit measured target/offset; earlier null boxes and guessed allocations are preserved in check/page-001-before-codex.json. The sequence on every row was read visually at 600 dpi. Codex applied independent reviewer repair-plan: 25 word rectangles,36 sign anchors,7 boundary signs, extra initial fatha removed. Full acceptance pending title and re-review.
provenance.raster_hash_method: pdftoppm -f 1 -l 1 -r 600 -singlefile -png; regenerated by Codex; transient whole-page PNG removed after hashing.
